title: Assays for studying normal versus suppressive ERAD-associated retrotranslocation pathways in yeast
protocol: Thaw dfm1Δ-null yeast cells containing GALpr-Hmg2-GFP from freezer by streaking cells directly on SC-His plates.
Incubate SC-His plate in a 30°C incubator for approximately 3 days.
Prepare starter culture by inoculating a single colony into 3 mL of minimal media-His supplemented with 2% raffinose.
Grow starter culture overnight (16–20 hours) until cells are grown to saturation (OD600 > 1).
Dilute cells to OD600 ∼0.1 in 3 mL of minimal media -His supplemented with 2% raffinose.
Incubate the culture at 30°C with rotation for 4–5 hours until cells reach early log phase (OD600 ∼0.2–0.3).
Designate this culture as Passage 0 (P0).
Once cells have grown to an OD600 of ∼0.3-0.8, induce expression by adding galactose to a final concentration of 0.2% (v/v).
Incubate at 30°C with rotation for ∼24 hours or until cells are grown to saturation (OD600>1).
Dilute cells to OD600 ∼0.1 in 3 mL of minimal media -His supplemented with 1.8% raffinose/0.2% galactose.
Incubate the culture at 30°C with rotation for 24 hours or until cells are grown to saturation (OD600>1).
Designate this new culture as Passage 1 (P1).
Passage cells immediately after cultures reach saturation phase and continue passaging until dfm1Δ-null cells are completely suppressed.
It is critical to passage cells promptly to avoid sustained growth in the saturation phase.
Thaw dfm1Δ-null yeast cells containing GALpr-Hmg2-GFP.
Inoculate and passage dfm1Δ-null yeast cells as indicated above.
Induce dfm1Δ-null yeast cells containing GALpr-Hmg2-GFP with galactose for at least two hours.
Grow induced yeast cells to an OD600 of approximately 0.4.
Take 300 μL of P0 cells for analysis.
Analyze mean fluorescence levels using a BD Biosciences FACS Calibur flow cytometer.
Set the run settings on the flow cytometer to limits at 10,000 events.
Adjust fluidics settings for medium flow rate suitable for yeast.
Draw Gate 1 (in red) on density plots to isolate intact yeast cells.
Use Gate 1 cell population to generate histograms with the number of cells versus GFP fluorescence.
Aliquot 300 μl of suspended cells into sample tubes.
Place the tube on the sample collector.
Create two plots for each run: density (side scatter SSC vs. forward scatter FSC) and histogram plots (Cell Count vs. 530 filter for GFP FITC-A).
Draw a gate around the population of intact yeast cells.
Display gated population as a histogram to obtain the mean fluorescence.
Allow cells to double in fresh minimal media until OD600 is approximately 0.4.
Analyze cells for mean fluorescence via flow cytometer.
Perform all flow cytometry readings directly from minimal media.
Thaw dfm1Δ-null yeast cells containing GALpr-Hmg2-GFP from freezer by streaking on SC-His plates.
Incubate SC-His plate in 30°C incubator for ∼3 days.
Inoculate a single colony into 3 mL of minimal media supplemented with 2% raffinose.
Incubate at 30°C with rotation overnight (16–20 h) until cells are grown to saturation (OD600>1).
Dilute cells to OD600 ∼0.1 and incubate with rotation at 30°C for 4–5 h; allowing cells to double or grow to an early log-phase with OD600 ∼0.2–0.3.
Pellet 0.12 OD of cells by spinning at 14,000 × g for 2 min at room temperature and resuspend pellets in 1 mL of sterilized dH2O.
Transfer 250 μL of each sample to a 96-well plate and perform a five-fold serial dilution in dH2O of each sample to obtain a gradient of 0.03–0.0000096 OD cells.
Pin the cells using the 8×12 pinning apparatus onto synthetic complete (-His) agar plates supplemented with 2% dextrose or 2% galactose.
Air-dry the pinned droplets of cells under the flame in sterile conditions.
Seal the plates with parafilm.
Incubate the sealed plates at 30°C.
Remove the plates from the incubator for imaging with the ChemiDoc Imager (Setting: UV-Trans) or a camera on Day 3 and 7.
Pellet 0.12 OD of cells once suppression is validated by flow cytometry.
Follow steps 5–10 for growth analysis of suppressed passaged cells.
Thaw dfm1Δ-null yeast cells containing GALpr-Hmg2-GFP from freezer by streaking directly on SC-His plates.
Incubate SC-His plate in 30°C incubator for ∼3 days.
Inoculate a single colony into 10 mL of minimal media supplemented with 2% raffinose.
Incubate the culture at 30°C with rotation overnight (16–20 h) until cells are grown to saturation (OD600>1).
Dilute cells to OD600 ∼0.1 in fresh minimal media supplemented with 2% raffinose (total volume=50 mL in 250 mL Erlenmeyer flask).
Incubate with shaking at 30°C for 4 hours.
Remove 3 mL of cell suspension and add to a culture tube once cells have grown to early-log phase (OD600∼0.2–0.3).
Add MG132 at a final concentration of 25 μg/mL to the rest of the culture (∼47 mL) after allowing cells to grow.
Incubate for 1 hour with shaking.
Pellet 15 OD of cells in 50 mL falcon tubes by centrifuging at 1,000 × g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Discard supernatant and resuspend the pellets in sterile deionized water.
Centrifuge at 1,000 × g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Dilute passaged suppressed cells to an OD600 ∼0.1 in fresh minimal media supplemented with 1.8% raffinose/0.2% galactose (total volume= 50 mL) and incubate with shaking at 30°C for 4 h.
Resuspend passaged and non-passaged cell pellets in 400 μL of sterile deionized water and divide samples into 4×2 mL Eppendorf tubes (∼100 μL per tube).
Spin the tubes at 10,000 × g rpm for 2 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant from each tube.
Resuspend each pellet with 100 μL of MF buffer supplemented with specific protease inhibitors.
Add 0.5 mM silicone beads to meniscus of cell suspension in each tube.
Vortex samples on multi-vortexer set at top speed for 6 × 1-min intervals, with 10 min intervals on ice between vortexing.
Check cells under the microscope (20× magnification) for lysis efficiency.
Keep samples and all solutions on ice.
Add 100 μL of chilled MF buffer with PIs to each eppendorf tube.
Transfer lysates to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube using a 1 mL pipette.
Centrifuge the sample at 2,500 × g for 5 min at 4°C to remove cell debris.
Transfer clarified supernatant to an ultracentrifugation tube.
Ultracentrifuge the clarified lysate at 100,000 × g for 15 min at 4°C.
Resuspend pellet in 200 μL SUME buffer with PIs and NEM.
Add 600 μL of IPB with PIs and NEM to both (S) fraction and resuspended (P) fraction.
For Hmg2-GFP immunoprecipitation, add 15 μL of rabbit polyclonal anti-GFP antisera to the (P) and (S) samples.
Incubate the samples on ice for 5 min.
Spin the samples at 14,000 × g for 5 min.
Transfer supernatant to a new 1.5 mL eppendorf tube.
Incubate overnight with gentle mixing using a nutator at 4°C.
For equilibrating Protein A-Sepharose, add Protein-A Sepharose to a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Rinse the beads six times with deionized water on ice.
Add 6 mL of IPB after final rinse with water.
Store the solution at 4°C for future use.
Add 100 μL of equilibrated Protein A-Sepharose to the samples.
Incubate for 2 h at 4°C with gentle mixing using a nutator.
Wash Protein A-Sepharose beads twice by adding 900 μL of IPB followed by brief spin of 1,000 × g for 30 s at room temperature and aspirating supernatant with an 18-gauge syringe needle.
Repeat washing with addition of IPB to beads.
Wash beads once more by adding 900 μL of IPW followed by brief spin of 1,000 × g for 30 s at room temperature and aspirating beads to dryness using a 30-gauge syringe needle.
Resuspend beads in 60 μL of 2× urea sample buffer.
Solubilize samples by incubating at 55°C for 10 min.
Spin samples at 14,000 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Remove eluted proteins to a new tube.
Resolve eluted proteins by SDS-PAGE using 8% gels.
Transfer proteins to nitrocellulose membrane by electroblotting at 15 mAmp for 15 min using a TransBlot.
Immunoblot with monoclonal anti-ubiquitin (1:4,000 dilution).
Immunoblot with anti-GFP (1:10,000 dilution).
Recognize primary antibodies with Goat anti-mouse conjugated with horseradish peroxidase.
